title: How to detect and handle an unresponsive feature
problem: An embedded feature can hang, crash, or lose its tab throttling fight; I need the host to notice within seconds, tell the user honestly, and recover when it returns.
outcome: A host that keeps SDK liveness and product silence apart, reacts to all four liveness states with honest UI, measures round-trip latency with a correlated request, and recovers cleanly when the feature comes back.

knowledge: The feature's contract, so you know which events prove it is working
